QUOTE: Query has more than one token | "NOT definitive". Per-token hit counts show which token matched nothing... The conjunction emptied it, not necessarily the repo.

VERDICT: MISS

WHY: The answer describes the current graded design. It never says a single token matching nothing was previously treated as proof of absence, and it never frames the confusion between "nothing exists" and "I did not look there." Its multi-token note is about conjunction, which is a different point.
